turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Cabo San Lucas officials inspected seven neighbourhoods to clear silt and reopen roads after recent rains. Palabra BCS reported this on October 28.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Seven neighbourhoods. That already shows how much the rains hit local roads.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: They are also watching arroyo crossings because more mountain rain is forecast.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the immediate transport problem is silt blocking streets and possible flooding at crossings. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Exactly. This is Radio BCS2050, and today we are looking at Transport.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What concrete question will the reporting answer?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: How are current road repairs and bus services actually working in BCS right now.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Residents are also calling a signature drive to keep the East Cape Coastal Road in the 2040 urban plan.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: And rain and sewage spills are damaging the Transpeninsular highway in Los Cabos right now.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That feels like the right place to start.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: In La Paz the council approved two buses to extend the Tiburón Urbano service to El Centenario and Chametla.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Baja Ferries seeks to turn Sea of Cortez crossings into a full holiday experience for passengers. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What would that actually look like for people crossing regularly between the coasts?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Riders already report the new 16 peso fare being charged before official publication. [pause] What happens when the official date arrives?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: We will track how these repairs and route changes shape daily movement in the coming months.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Palabra BCS reported on October 28 that Cabo San Lucas officials inspected road damage in seven neighbourhoods after recent rains.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They cleared silt from the streets and reopened several crossings while watching arroyo levels for more mountain rain.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The crews focused on arroyo crossings that often flood first after heavy rain.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That choice keeps the main routes open for the longest time possible.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The work keeps daily traffic moving in those zones.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Local residents rely on those roads to reach work and school each day.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What happens if the next storm hits before the arroyos are fully checked?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same crews would have to repeat the inspections quickly.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Inspecting seven zones after every rain event stretches the crews thin.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Exactly, and the forecast already warns of more rain from the mountains.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep wondering how the crews decide which crossing to check first.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They probably start with the busiest ones near the main routes.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Now the other transport story from La Paz.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Palabra BCS reported on October 13 that some drivers already charge the new urban bus fare of 16 pesos. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The council approved the rise from 12 pesos on October 6.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? And the suburban routes now cost 18 pesos to Chametla and El Centenario.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That change adds up fast for regular riders.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The new amounts still had not appeared in the municipal gazette when charging began.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Riders noticed the difference on their morning commute.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: One driver told passengers the change was already in force.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: How does an extra four pesos affect someone who rides twice a day?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Over a month that adds up for families on fixed incomes.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Workers who live outside the city centre feel that increase first.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They often travel the suburban routes to reach jobs in La Paz.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Both stories show how weather and fares shape daily movement across the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Road crews respond after each rain while fare rules still wait for formal publication.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep thinking about the riders who already paid the higher amount before it was official.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They had no choice at the time.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The next step is whether the gazette publication matches what drivers are collecting now.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That single detail decides if the increase is legal yet.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: It leaves commuters wondering who sets the final timeline.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Exactly, and whether any refunds will follow if the rules change.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What would you ask the transport office about the timing?

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I would ask how they plan to keep the fare updates clear for everyone.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Clear rules help avoid confusion on the bus each morning.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Palabra BCS reported on October 28 that Cabo San Lucas officials inspected seven neighbourhoods after recent rains.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: They cleared silt from roads and reopened them while watching arroyo crossings.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: More mountain rain was forecast, so crews stayed on alert for further damage.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That work keeps the main routes into Los Cabos moving for daily traffic.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Los Cabos serves as the primary international gateway with SJD airport and the hotel cluster.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: When silt blocks those roads, it hits the south’s fiscal engine first.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The East Cape corridor to La Paz also relies on the same network.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Any slowdown there affects the lower-density coastal growth planned for San José del Este.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Tribuna de México noted on October 20 that eight hopefuls registered for Morena’s coordinator post in Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Former mayor Óscar Leggs is among them [chuckle].

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Those posts will shape municipal decisions through 2027.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Road maintenance and arroyo management sit directly under those responsibilities.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Water scarcity already limits how much new pavement or drainage can be added.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Peak energy loads make large equipment upgrades harder too.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The inspection shows crews responding quickly, yet the underlying arroyo crossings remain exposed.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Residents still face repeated closures whenever heavy rain arrives from the mountains.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The question is how the next municipal team will budget for permanent fixes.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: We keep watching the same seven zones Palabra BCS listed.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Tribuna de México also counted at least 21 hopefuls across BCS for these posts.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Seven of those hopefuls come from La Paz alone.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Saúl González Núñez registered there while on leave as secretary general of government.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That detail changes how the La Paz race looks.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Three of them registered in Mulegé for the coordinator role.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Two signed up in Comondú while one appeared in Loreto.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That one in Loreto is Mayor Paz Ochoa on the list.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That one in Loreto is Mayor Paz Ochoa on the list. [laugh]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The report stresses that registrations are not official candidacies [pause].

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: How might the next team handle arroyo fixes with water limits in mind?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: East Cape growth along the corridor could stay vulnerable without upgrades.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Lower density appeal there depends on reliable road access year round.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Meganoticias reported on November 16 that rain and a sewage spill from the Los Cabos water utility have damaged the Transpeninsular highway surface near San José del Cabo.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The SCT office acknowledged the problem on the shoulders of that stretch and called for a full assessment that also fixes the drainage.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That same week Diario Humano covered residents in Los Cabos collecting signatures to keep the East Cape Coastal Road in the 2040 plan as a rustic route.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Grupo Questro wants a highway at least one kilometre inland, while Implan prefers a scenic drive with beach access.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Meanwhile HOY BCS noted the La Paz council approved two new buses to extend the Tiburón Urbano route into El Centenario and Chametla using federal Ramo 33 funds.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The move follows years of complaints about scarce public transport in those areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: El Economista added that Baja Ferries already moves over 200,000 passengers a year on its Sea of Cortez routes.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? And they want to reach 300 to 400,000 with hotel packages.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: 90% of goods reaching BCS arrive by sea, so any change in land routes affects the whole supply chain.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Tribuna de México said the Los Cabos council will repair tracks after the 2026 Baja 1000, negotiating with landowners along the new sections.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The state tourism undersecretary noted that off-road tours and other races already wear the same paths year-round.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: NTCD reported the BCS government handed out 840 transport concessions in Los Cabos after more than a decade of driver demands.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The goal is legal certainty and to curb irregular operations at some hotels.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The knowledge graph shows El Vizcaíno Biosphere Reserve sits across the northern spine of the peninsula and directly conditions any widening of the Transpeninsular.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Earth Studio mapped 956 points statewide.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: And found 213 inside protected areas.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: With 165 of those on the Vizcaíno stretch alone.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Only three of those points are tourism resorts, so the constraint comes from the reserve boundary itself, not visitor pressure.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That explains why every northern corridor project must start from the ANP lock rather than from demand forecasts.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same mapping shows 72 points where coast and protected zones overlap, which ties directly into the East Cape Coastal Road debate.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: But here's the thing: the study also records 169 points near the coast overall, meaning any new scenic route would still run into the same environmental limits.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the hidden thread is that geography and protected-area rules shape every road, bus extension and ferry connection we just discussed.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mm. [chuckle] It makes the sewage spill on the Transpeninsular look less like an isolated fix and more like part of that larger lock.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Did you know new buses for La Paz public transport were announced for March 2026?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Really? That comes from Sheinbaum's first government report.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yes, the state site lists the modernization of La Paz transport with new units expected around that date.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mm. That announcement came during her tour of the state.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: No exact count appears yet, only the March window.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That leaves some uncertainty about the scale of the upgrade.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Think about someone catching the bus to work each morning instead of waiting in the heat for an older one.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: That everyday change could cut travel time on regular routes.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: [pause] It would help families plan their days better around reliable schedules.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: I keep thinking about how a single new bus affects the whole morning commute for families near the malecón.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The same report also mentions repaving work on the Transpeninsular highway.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Right, conservation and resurfacing announced during the same tour.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: One stretch fixed means fewer potholes for delivery trucks heading north from La Paz.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Fewer potholes could also mean less wear on vehicles over time.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: How does that connect to the rest of the state?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Better road surfaces support movement between municipalities where people rely on the highway daily.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Especially for those traveling to work or school across longer distances.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal lists both projects under the same federal visit.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet the sources do not say how many buses or which exact highway segments first.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: So the timeline stays the main concrete detail we have.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Still, March 2026 gives a clear window for residents to watch.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: True. [chuckle] I keep wondering which routes will see the first new units.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That question stays open until the rollout begins.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Residents in La Paz can track updates on the state site once the first vehicles roll out.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The Base de datos BCS 2050 notes from 30 sep 2026 list mesas de trabajo that include Desarrollo orientado al transporte.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: How many working groups sit in that same list?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Eight in total.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? [pause] That number already shows how many other topics share the table with transport.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The entry places that mesa next to Hospitalidad and Inversión extranjera.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: And also next to Infraestructura y energía under SEPUIMM.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Urbanización Los Cabos and Agua under CEA and CONAGUA appear in the same row.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the transport-oriented group is one node inside a larger state planning network.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Cervero and Arrington’s TCRP Report 122 from 2004 gives the US evidence on how those tables might affect land values.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Their findings showed measurable premiums near stations once zoning matched the service.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Renne’s 2005 NCHRP framework supplied the outcome indicators to track whether the same pattern shows up here.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That still leaves the northern corridors and how they fit inside the same rule set.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The knowledge graph states that El Vizcaíno Biosphere Reserve conditions any widening of the Transpeninsular between Guerrero Negro and Vizcaíno.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The Earth Studio stills confirm that 165 of the Vizcaíno spine frames fall inside the ANP boundary.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Only three of those frames contain a tourism resort, so density is not the controlling variable.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The rule therefore begins at the protected-area lock rather than at traffic counts.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Ewing and Cervero’s 2001 JAPA synthesis already linked built-environment variables to travel demand.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Yet the ANP overlay sits on top of that earlier work.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Any new node on the Mulegé–Vizcaíno paquete must start from that constraint.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The corridor_intensify scenario for Cabos–La Paz adds the East Cape flank under ANP Pulmo tension.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The statewide study examined 956 stills joined to roads and protected zones.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That sample size already covers most of the key corridors.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: One everyday object, a kilometre marker on the Transpeninsular, therefore carries the full stack of those earlier reports and the current ANP conditions. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I keep wondering which mesa would first have to revise its minutes if that marker moved.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The same 956 frames show 283 areas under some protection layer overall.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So any change would touch multiple overlapping rules at once.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal's Vision pillar on Mobility opens with GAP's 2026 figures for the two main airports.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those airport figures come from the operator's October report for both terminals.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: SJD recorded a drop of 4.6 percent last October.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: And 5.5 percent for the first ten months of the year.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: LAP showed an increase of 8.7 percent year to date.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal reads those numbers as signs that growth is concentrating in Los Cabos while La Paz gains modest ground.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? That concentration feels like it could strain one area while others stay quiet.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mobility accounts for three items this week with an EWMA at 2.67.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The direction sits at plus zero point zero zero so the period reads mixed or neutral. [chuckle]

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The aspiration is connectivity that supports a polycentric state rather than repeating the SJD–Los Cabos corridor everywhere.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: LAP traffic counts and existing Sea of Cortez ferry routes are treated as current levers, not future targets.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Paving projects and traffic data are framed as serving inland communities first.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those choices could ease pressure on the main tourist road without adding new coastal builds right away.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The Tendencia 2050 describes Baja California Sur as a set of distinct roles rather than one repeated coastal pattern.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Los Cabos remains the tourism engine but faces water and power limits.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: La Paz is positioned as the service capital and water-energy node.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That split keeps services from piling up in one spot while the rest of the state waits.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Loreto serves as a tourism-conservation anchor.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Comondú keeps its agricultural base with more available capacity.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Northern Mulegé appears as a corridor with a remote generation tender under way.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: The conditions listed are that each area keeps its own vocation and new growth occurs only where water and energy margins are documented.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: East Cape and Loreto must stay within ANP and POEL limits before expanding hospitality.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Those protected-area rules and local land plans act as hard stops, not suggestions.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The watchlist flags the El Tezal partial plan now in public consultation by IMPLAN Los Cabos.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: It also includes the Los Cabos urban plan update that carries density limits and the Cabo del Este coastal road proposal.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Those items remain under review, so the outcome for transport patterns is still open.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What would you ask the planners at IMPLAN about the density limits?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: What stands out is how the same airports and ferry links can either reinforce one corridor or begin to balance several.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Not limited to the SJD to Los Cabos axis.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: LAP traffic and maritime routes are treated as levers already in view.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: What does that shift for Baja California Sur?

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Development responsibilities would need to spread across more regions instead of concentrating in one corridor.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Who carries those responsibilities stays unspecified in the vision.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: The portal also leaves open how soon those levers would move beyond current patterns.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: So the documented part is the stated direction, and the uncertain part is the path to it.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: [pause] That distinction keeps the aspiration useful without turning it into a forecast.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: I keep thinking how that changes daily planning for people outside the main corridor.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Mm, it does [chuckle]. It might mean more attention to routes like the ones La Paz council is extending with additional buses.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: Really? Two buses to reach El Centenario and Chametla would already test that spread.

turns.speaker: cohost
turns.text: That practical step shows how local moves could feed the wider goal.

turns.speaker: host
turns.text: Yet the portal leaves unclear who would coordinate those moves across municipalities.
